en-IN.name: Try1Second
en-IN.summary: Compare live prices across Indian sellers with your voice.
en-IN.description: Ask Try1Second for any price and it reads out the lowest verified price and the sellers it compared: products, grocery, credit cards, loans, insurance, bus, flights, hotels, cabs and movie tickets. Prices come from a live scan of the sellers' own pages, and the full comparison opens on try1second.com.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask try one second to compare iPhone 16
Alexa, ask try one second for bus from Indore to Bhopal

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Say: open try one second, then 'compare iPhone 16 price'. The skill answers with the lowest verified price found live, and the Alexa app card links to try1second.com.
